notes.title: 💡 "HYDROCITY UPDATE" — A Brand-New Beginning!
notes.content:
💡 "HYDROCITY UPDATE" — A Brand-New Beginning!
Hydroplant Tycoon returns with a fresh city theme, dynamic NPCs, a slapping mechanic, a revamped growing system, and a completely redesigned user interface!

🌆 You're being watched — welcome to the city.
🌱 Growing is now deeper, smoother, and more satisfying.
👊 Slap thieves! But be careful — hitting the wrong person will cost you.
📘 Learn all the game mechanics with the new “Farmer’s Handbook”!
🎮 A new character model, visualized animations, and a simplified HUD offer a whole new experience.

In the heart of the city, where nature meets technology — make your mark.
Hydroplant is no longer just a simulation — it's your story now!

🚀 New & Improved Systems:

New City Theme & Dynamic NPCs: People now visit your plot, but not all come with good intentions — some may try to steal from you.

Day-Night Cycle: Production is only available from 8 AM to 5 PM — and that’s when thieves are active, too.

Visualized Animations: Objects now move and settle into place with smooth, eye-catching transitions.

Slapping Mechanic: You're free to slap a thief — but hit an innocent by mistake and you’ll pay a $10 fine!

New Character Model & Animations: See your own animations as you carry and place items from a third-person perspective.

Redesigned HUD & Purchase Menu: Cleaner, more intuitive interface. Access the buy menu instantly with the B key.

New “Farmer’s Handbook” (Press H): All core mechanics are explained step by step — no more guesswork.

Improved Save System: Plants inside transport boxes are no longer lost after saving; only those in the growing phase are affected.

New Greenhouse & Expansion System: Grow your land freely. The more organized you are, the better you're protected from thieves.

notes.title: HYDROPLANT Tycoon V0.2.84-150525 Update
notes.content:
Dear HYDROPLANT Tycoon players!

Thank you for your feedback on the bugs and gameplay in our game.

The fixes we made with this version of the game are as follows;

- Mouse sensitivity setting added to the settings menu,
- Night - Day cycle added to the game,
- Growth - rest time added for plants and sprouts,
- Fixed the problem of the game controller becoming inoperable when the menu is closed,
- Time skip window added (you can access it with the T button at certain times.),
- Water texture corrected for water bottle,
- Lights added for night lighting,
- Saving of the accepted job added,
- Autonomous systems disabled for improvement and development work.

The major updates we are actively working on for the game are as follows;

- Loan system,
- Detailed story and tutorial mode,
- Multiplayer sandbox mode,

Thank you all for your interest and support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564946/6dc4a9fcac2df1c7c2d478cd32200f7d2cad9429.png[/img]

notes.title: HYDROPLANT Tycoon V0.2 Update
notes.content:
Dear HYDROPLANT Tycoon lovers;

In the limited time left for the release of our game, we have successfully added the latest work that our team has been working on to our game.

The added features are as follows;
- Autonomous soilless farming features,
- Plant production without touching with conveyor systems,
- Quests,
- Jobs,
- In-game monetary structure arrangements,
- Widget animations,
- Bug-Fixes,
- Simple plant freezer system,

And many more will be with you.

Our team is eagerly waiting for your feedback during this process and what kind of content you would like to see in the HYDROPLANT Tycoon game.

We would like to state that our game is on its way to reaching the full version. We want our game to be built with your directives. We are waiting for your feedback.

Thank you all!
